cross_source_machine_agreement.evidence_boundary_affirmation: Cross-source machine agreement is strictly limited to 6 annual event counts and 6 paired annual deltas. Whole-ledger integrity, all timestamp identities, zero historical defect, or independent end-to-end replay are NOT asserted.

cohort_mismatch_findings.boundary_qualification: Difference in cohort counts cannot identify shifted events. Exit accepted-ID date spans cannot be attributed to H18 accepted IDs or receiver clock.

continuation_12to18h.statistical_inference_boundary: No inference regarding 50/50, lack of edge, or statistical significance is asserted; sample proportion is descriptive only.

ex_post_right_tail_concentration.trade_signal_validity: Retrospective attribution only; not an actionable ex-ante trade signal or classifier.
